title: AODB SQL Database Unauthorized Access — Gate Randomization Script

lines.msg: Unauthorized admin login detected from session 0x9A2F1E8D. Source IP: 10.66.1.22 (OPS_INTERN_03).
Session 0x9A2F1E8D executed stored procedure [sp_update_flight_assignments] with parameter 'gate_randomize = TRUE'.
Script 'random_gate_generator.ps1' executed from path C:\Scripts\AODB\Automated\. This script modifies gate assignments across all active flights in the AODB.
Gate assignments for 42 flights have been randomized. New assignments: UA 2401 → Gate 14, DL 666 → Gate B6, AA 512 → Gate A3, WN 888 → Gate 8.
Script execution completed. No error logs generated.
Script 'random_gate_generator.ps1' has not been approved in change control. Hash: 7A9F2D8C3E1B4F6A2C5D9E0F1B8C7D3A.
Audit trail preserved. All actions logged to C:\Logs\AODB\Audit\20261022_AuditTrail.log.

instructorNote: This is a core inject confirming the attack vector and malicious payload. The IT Lead must now report the script execution and unauthorized access. Watch for Ops to assess whether to shut down FIDS to prevent further data corruption.
